home.heroTitle: One link in bio. Every language in the world.
home.heroSubtitle: Linketto is the multilingual link-in-bio page: your profile speaks each visitor's language. Hosted in the EU, with reduced commissions and honest pricing.
home.featureLangBody: One page, many languages: visitors see your profile in their own language, automatically.
home.featureFeeBody: Just 8% on the free plan, 4% on Pro and 0% on Business and Founder.
home.featureAnalyticsBody: We count clicks, not people. No personal data and no consent banner.
home.featureTrustBody: Transparent moderation with notice and the right to appeal. Never a shameful banner on your page.
home.featureEuBody: Hosted in the EU, GDPR by default. The few providers outside the EU (payments, email, AI) are listed in the Privacy Policy.
home.featureDomainBody: Custom domains on paid plans — your reputation never depends on someone else's abuse.
home.featureAiBody: Write in your language — Linketto translates your profile into all the others with one button.
home.featureQrBody: A QR code in your color and a vCard block that saves your contact to any phone with one tap.
home.heroBadge: Multilingual link in bio · EU hosted
home.manifestoQuote: We will never show “BANNED” to your visitors. We moderate transparently — with notice, a human response and the right to appeal. The reputation you build stays yours.
home.manifestoBy: A promise from the Carbon Stealth team
home.ctaTitle: Speak to the whole world from one link.
home.faq1a: Linketto is a link in bio page: one link that gathers all your links, products and contacts. The unique part: your page speaks every visitor’s language — build it once and it shows in all 24 official EU languages.
home.faq2q: How is Linketto different from Linktree?
home.faq2a: Four things: your profile has versions in every language and shows each visitor their own automatically; it is hosted in the EU with GDPR by default; analytics are cookie-free with no personal data; and you get your own domain from the Pro plan (€4/mo). A detailed comparison with sources and date is on the “Linketto vs Linktree” page.
home.faq3a: The Free plan is genuinely free — unlimited links and 2 language versions. Pro is €4/mo (all languages, custom domain), Business is €9/mo (0% commission, up to 5 profiles), and Founder is a one-time €49 — Pro forever with 0% commission.
home.faq4q: How does the multilingual profile work?
home.faq4a: Visitors automatically see your profile in their language (from their browser settings) or pick one on the page. You write in your language and the built-in AI translation fills in the rest with one click — your manual translations are never overwritten.
home.faq5a: Yes. Connect your Stripe account from the dashboard and add products priced in euro. Buyers pay on your page and the secret delivery link unlocks only after a confirmed payment. The commission follows your plan (8/4/0/0%) plus a 1.9% + €0.30 processing fee.

legal.privacyBody:
Controller: Carbon Stealth VCC, company ID BG208725180, 3 Samuil St, 2670 Bobov Dol, Bulgaria, info@carbonstealth.eu.

In short: we collect only what the service needs; we never sell data; we use no advertising or tracking technologies; profile visitors receive no cookies; data stays in the EU and leaves it only to Stripe (payments), Resend (email, USA) and — on your explicit action — to Google (AI translation and bio generation).

What we process and why · Account: email, hashed password, chosen language — to run the service (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, contract). Profile content: names, descriptions, links, images — published by you. Contact-form messages: name, email, text — delivered to the profile owner (Art. 6(1)(f), legitimate interest — communication you requested); kept for up to 12 months. Booking requests ("Booking" block): name, email, preferred time, message — delivered to the profile owner on the same basis; kept for up to 12 months. Purchases: buyer email and amount — for delivery and accounting (Art. 6(1)(b) and legal obligation). Analytics: cookie-free, no IPs, no personal data — we only count views and clicks (Art. 6(1)(f)). Weekly report: if you have a published profile, once a week we email you a summary — number of visits and your visitors' languages, with no personal data about them — based on legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) in keeping you informed about how your page performs; you can object at any time (Art. 21) — in 1 click from any report or from your dashboard; the objection is honoured unconditionally. Import from Linktree: only on your action and only for your own public page, we fetch its public content (links, titles, bio, avatar) and add it to your profile (Art. 6(1)(b)); the avatar is re-encoded and EXIF data is removed. The free QR code generator runs entirely in your browser — nothing is sent to us.

Sign-in security · When you sign in to your account we record the device's IP address and keep it for 90 days (Art. 6(1)(f), abuse protection). This never applies to profile visitors.

Recipients and transfers · Stripe Payments Europe Ltd processes payments; transfers to Stripe Inc (USA) rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses. Google (Gemini API): only when you press "Translate with AI" or "Generate bio" yourself (including in the free bio tool without sign-up), we send the name, description or notes you entered (US transfer under DPF + SCC); the bio tool stores nothing on our side, and for its rate limit the IP address is kept only in server memory for up to 1 hour (Art. 6(1)(f), abuse prevention). Purchase delivery by email: Resend, Inc. (USA) processes the buyer's email and the delivery message on our behalf — solely to deliver the link and the receipt, under Standard Contractual Clauses. An EU hosting provider. Beyond those — nobody. We never sell data or use it for advertising.

Invitations · When you sign up via an invite, we record who invited you so we can credit their bonus (Art. 6(1)(b)); they see only the number of sign-ups and payments from their invites, not who you are. To pay out a bonus we process the account you provide (IBAN/PayPal/Revolut) — Art. 6(1)(b) and (c); the payout record is kept for the period required by accounting law (10 years).

Retention · Account: while it exists + 30 days (if there are purchases, the account is anonymised and the purchase records are kept for 10 years). Contact-form messages and booking requests: 12 months. Newsletter subscribers: until unsubscribe — unsubscribing deletes the email; unconfirmed sign-ups: 30 days. Purchase records: 10 years (accounting law). Analytics events: up to 13 months.

Your rights · Access, rectification, erasure, restriction (Art. 18), portability, objection (Art. 21) and withdrawal of consent at any time (Art. 7(3)) — write to info@carbonstealth.eu. You may lodge a complaint with the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (CPDP, www.cpdp.bg) or your local supervisory authority. We do not use automated decision-making under Art. 22.

Cookies · We use up to three strictly necessary cookies — two httpOnly, to sign in to your account and for buyers to access paid content, and one that remembers your chosen language (up to 12 months). Details in the Cookie policy.

Newsletter · If you subscribe to a creator's newsletter, we process your email and language on the basis of your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) with double opt-in; the content is the creator's (the creator is the controller, Linketto the processor under Art. 28). We keep the data until you unsubscribe (every email has an unsubscribe link). Course/membership buyers · to access paid content we store your email and issue a one-time sign-in link and session (up to 30 days). All transactional and newsletter emails (confirmations, deliveries, receipts, access links, newsletters, weekly reports) are sent via Resend, Inc. (USA) on the basis of SCCs/DPF.

Changes · We will notify you at your account email about material changes.
legal.termsBody:
Linketto is a service of Carbon Stealth VCC (ID BG208725180, 3 Samuil St, 2670 Bobov Dol, Bulgaria, info@carbonstealth.eu).

Content and moderation · Illegal content, impersonation, phishing, malicious links and misleading information are prohibited. Anyone can report a profile via the "Report" link on every public profile or at info@carbonstealth.eu (point of contact under Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 — DSA). We handle reports diligently and without arbitrariness. If we act against your content, you receive a statement of reasons and may appeal to us; you may also complain to your Digital Services Coordinator. Profiles are not suspended without prior notice, except for grave abuse requiring immediate action by law. We never show "BANNED" to your visitors.

Plans and payments · Paid plans are billed via Stripe; you can cancel at any time and the plan stays active until the end of the paid period. The Founder plan is a one-time payment and is never revoked.

Shop · Linketto is a platform: the purchase contract is concluded between the buyer and the creator (seller). Sales carry a commission according to the seller's plan (8/4/0/0%) plus a payment processing fee of 1.9% + €0.30. For VAT purposes Linketto (Carbon Stealth VCC) acts as the deemed supplier (Article 9a of Implementing Regulation (EU) 282/2011) and charges and accounts for the VAT due on the sale price based on the buyer's country; displayed prices are final, VAT included where due. The income from your sales is yours — you are responsible for declaring and paying the taxes and social contributions due in your country. Only pre-made digital content (files, pre-recorded courses) may be sold through the shop; selling live or personalised services (consultations, live lessons, custom work) is not permitted. Digital content is delivered immediately after a confirmed payment — for a course, full access to all content is granted in its entirety at the moment of purchase — that is why at checkout you give express consent and acknowledge losing the 14-day right of withdrawal (Art. 16(m), Directive 2011/83/EU). Each product shows whether the seller is a trader or a private individual — by the seller’s own declaration. When the seller is a trader, they are responsible for performing the contract and for the statutory conformity guarantee for digital content (Directive (EU) 2019/770), regardless of the immediate-delivery consent. If the seller is not a trader, EU consumer rights do not apply to the purchase.

Invite programme · Every account has a personal invite link; on free profiles the “Create your free page” badge carries the profile owner's link. When an invited user pays for a plan, the owner earns a bonus of 15% of the amount paid. The bonus can be withdrawn once at least €100 has accrued; you are responsible for declaring it as income. Self-invites and fake accounts void the bonus.

Import · You import only your own content. By ticking “This is my page” you confirm that the page is yours and that you hold the rights to its content.

Liability · You are responsible for the content you publish and the products you sell. We are not liable for the content of external sites your links lead to.

Governing law · Bulgarian law; Bulgarian courts have jurisdiction, without prejudice to mandatory consumer rights in your country.
legal.cookiesBody:
Linketto uses up to three strictly necessary cookies: two httpOnly — to sign in to your account and for buyers to access paid content (course/membership, up to 30 days) — and one functional cookie that remembers your chosen language (NEXT_LOCALE, up to 12 months), set when you visit the site pages. They do not track your behaviour and are never shared.

Visitors of public profiles receive no cookies at all. Our analytics are cookie-free: we count views and clicks without IP addresses, without user agents and without any personal data.

Because we use no advertising, analytics or tracking cookies, no consent banner is required (strictly necessary cookies under the ePrivacy rules). Payments are processed on Stripe’s pages, which sets its own cookies under its own policy.

Questions: info@carbonstealth.eu.
